suppress.notes: CVE-2026-54515 affects jackson-databind 2.21.x and 2.22.0 (managed by Spring Boot 3.5.15 BOM). No patched release is available yet. Suppress until a fixed version is published.
CVE-2026-53914 affects kotlin-stdlib 2.4.0 (pinned to avoid CVE-2020-29582 on older versions). No patched release is available yet. Suppress until a fixed version is published.

Spring Framework 6.2.x is EOL with no public fix for these CVEs. Fixed in Spring Framework 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4.0.8+). Upgrading to Spring Boot 4.x is required for a public OSS fix. CVE-2026-59313: Stream corruption when using SSE with the functional web framework. CVE-2026-59314: HTTP response splitting via Content-Disposition from untrusted filename input. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59313 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59314 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-47892 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-47893 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59280 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59283

Spring Cloud Commons 4.3.x has no public fix for CVE-2026-59284. Upgrading to a later version with a public OSS fix is required. CVE-2026-59284: Spring Cloud Commons vulnerability. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59284

Spring Security 6.5.x is EOL with no public fix for CVE-2026-59270. Fixed in Spring Security 7.0.7/7.1.1 (Spring Boot 4.x). CVE-2026-59270 affects the embedded UnboundID LDAP server (UnboundIdContainer) which is not used in this application. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59270
